name: The extremal principle
definition: Look at the largest, the smallest, or the leftmost object, because the extreme one often has no room to misbehave. Arguments that go nowhere in general frequently collapse in one line once you consider the extreme case.
recognizeWhen: consider the largest of the numbers
take the person standing furthest left
there must be a smallest one
misconceptions: I reasoned about a typical object instead of the extreme one.
I picked the largest object but did not use the fact that nothing is larger.
I assumed an extreme object exists when the collection could be infinite.
